azureLogAnalytics.query:
uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]' 
| where SessionProtocol_s == "ICA"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID_g) by Computer

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| where SessionConnectionState_s == "disconnected"
| where SessionProtocol_s == "ICA"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by SessionGUID_g
| project Computer,SessionUser_s,SessionClientName_s,SessionClientIp_s,SessionClientVersion_s,SessionCPUUsagePercent_d,SessionWorkingSetMB_d,SessionNetKBPS_d

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionProtocol_s == "ICA"
| where SessionAppStateCtx_s != "active"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID_g)

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionProtocol_s == "ICA"
| summarize dcount(SessionUser_s)

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionProtocol_s == "ICA"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID_g)

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionConnectionState_s == "active"
| summarize ["Sessions"] = dcount(SessionGUID_g) by bin(TimeGenerated, [[Interval]])

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]' 
| where SessionProtocol_s == "RDP"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID_g) by Computer

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionProtocol_s == "RDP"
| summarize dcount(SessionUser_s)

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SessionProtocol_s == "RDP"
| summarize dcount(SessionGUID_g)

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| where SessionConnectionState_s == "active"
| where SessionProtocol_s == "ICA"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by SessionGUID_g
| project Computer,SessionUser_s,SessionClientName_s,SessionClientIp_s,SessionClientVersion_s,SessionID_d,SessionCPUUsagePercent_d,SessionWorkingSetMB_d,SessionNetKBPS_d

uberAgent_Session_SessionDetail_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Computer matches regex '[[Computer]]'
| where SessionConnectionState_s == "active"
| where SessionProtocol_s == "RDP"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by SessionGUID_g
| project Computer,SessionUser_s,SessionClientName_s,SessionClientIp_s,SessionClientVersion_s,SessionID_d,SessionCPUUsagePercent_d,SessionWorkingSetMB_d,SessionNetKBPS_d

uberAgent_Application_ApplicationInventory_CL
| distinct Computer
| project Computer = strcat('"', Computer, '"')
